title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview:


As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions to support the company's mission and goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities:


  • Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes
  • API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.
  • Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities:


  • Mentor junior developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to planning, daily stand-ups, and continuous collaboration to ensure timely delivery of high-quality software.



Competencies/Requirements:


  • Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL. Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.
  • Experience: At least 5 years of experience in backend development, with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

Responsabilidades

  • Atualização e controle do fluxo de caixa, assegurando o correto registro das movimentações financeiras;

  • Interface com áreas internas e fornecedores para resolução de pendências financeiras;
  • Identificação, análise e resolução de inconsistências financeiras, com proposição de melhorias;

  • Boa comunicação, organização e atenção aos detalhes;

  • Experiência construindo dashboards financeiros;
  • Conhecimento básico sobre tributos;
  • Vivência em empresas de alto crescimento ou startups;
  • Experiência prévia com processos de fechamento contábil e auditoria;
  • Experiência com melhoria contínua e otimização de processos financeiros.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

title: Video Editor – Part-Time, Remote (UGC, Beauty/Skincare)
description:
Hours: 20 hours/week

Location: Remote


About Wildfleur

Wildfleur is a fast-growing beauty brand now in over 600 Ulta Beauty stores nationwide within our first months on the market. We’ve earned multiple press mentions and industry awards, including Byrdie’s Best Vitamin C.


Role Overview

The Video Editor will produce short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram and paid ads that are engaging, trend-aware, and aligned with our brand. This role is ideal for someone who loves skincare and beauty, lives in social media culture, and knows how to turn raw footage into polished content that connects with our audience.


Key Responsibilities

  • Transform UGC, influencer clips, and brand shoots into ads that feel authentic, on-trend, and true to our brand identity.
  • Edit raw footage into short, engaging TikTok and Instagram videos.
  • Use eye-catching edits: clean transitions, quick cuts, trending sounds, and storytelling hooks.
  • Add captions, text overlays, music, and effects while keeping the skincare/beauty audience in mind.
  • Ensure videos are exported in the correct formats, resolutions, and aspect ratios for each platform (TikTok, Instagram, Reels, Stories, and paid ads).
  • Stay on top of TikTok & Instagram trends.
  • Keep video assets organized and workflows smooth for ongoing projects.


Qualifications

  • 2–3+ years of experience in video editing, with a strong portfolio of short-form content.
  • Proven track record of creating high-converting paid social media ads and working extensively with UGC.
  • Portfolio examples in beauty, skincare, or cosmetics content are preferred - you understand the audience and the aesthetics.
  • Fluent in English, both spoken and written, for seamless communication and creating platform-native captions.
  • Passionate about cosmetics/skincare culture - you enjoy this world and bring genuine interest into the content.
  • Experience editing with Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects.
  • Comfortable working in CapCut or mobile-friendly apps when quick, social-native edits are needed.
  • Up-to-date with social media culture, trends, hooks, and viral formats.
  • Strong technical knowledge of video requirements for social media (aspect ratios, frame rates, resolutions, file sizes, export settings).
  • Highly detail-oriented, delivering content that is both on-trend and brand-consistent.
  • A degree in a creative field (film, media, communications, design) or background in filming/content creation is a plus (not required).


Perks

  • Flexible remote schedule.
  • Be part of a supportive and creative team

title: AI Reasoning Engineer (Mathematics & Python)
description:
Company Description

MillionLogics, a trusted Oracle Partner, is a global IT solutions provider with offices in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specializes in delivering smart, scalable, and future-ready IT solutions to empower businesses to evolve and lead. With expertise in Data & AI, Cloud migrations, IT consulting, and enterprise application optimization, MillionLogics offers tailored services with a focus on client success. Supported by a team of over 50 AI & Oracle experts, MillionLogics combines cutting-edge technology with a commitment to delivering impactful outcomes. Learn more about our services on our website.


Role Description

We are seeking a highly analytical and computationally proficient individual to join our team with a strong research background. You will be instrumental in contributing to this role by either crafting challenging and insightful problems in your respective research domain, devising elegant computational solutions.


Offer Details:

  • Pay: $1500 per month (Net/take-home)
  • Mode of work - Fully Remote


Responsibilities:

  • Build multi-agent benchmark tasks that require multi-step mathematical reasoning, proof construction, or algorithmic problem-solving
  • Design problems that are genuinely hard for a single agent but decomposable — competition math, numerical analysis, combinatorial optimization, statistical inference
  • Create verification scripts that check mathematical correctness — numerical answers with appropriate tolerance, proof step validity, algorithm output correctness
  • Write clear problem statements with precise notation, definitions, and output format
  • Create decomposition guides that split problems into independent sub-computations or parallel solution strategies


Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years in mathematics, quantitative research, or computational science — competition math, university-level mathematics, or quantitative research background Python programming — NumPy, SciPy, or symbolic computation (SymPy) Experience writing mathematical proofs or formal derivations.
  • Ability to create problems with precise, verifiable answers — not subjective or open-ended.
  • Experience with AI coding benchmarks (SWE-bench, Terminal-bench) Comfortable with Docker — writing Dockerfiles, building images, and debugging container issues.
  • Understanding of numerical methods — floating point tolerance, convergence criteria, error bounds.


Strong plus:  

  • Experience creating math competition problems (AMC, AIME, Putnam, IMO, or similar). 
  • Research in mathematics, theoretical CS, or quantitative fields. 
  • Experience with automated theorem proving or formal verification. 
  • Knowledge of AI reasoning benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH, AIME, GPQA, ARC-AGI). 
  • Experience with large-scale numerical computation or scientific computing


Example of what you will produce:

A task requiring analysis of a system of 50 coupled differential equations modeling a chemical reaction network. The agent must determine equilibrium concentrations, stability conditions, and bifurcation points. Input includes the reaction network as a matrix, rate constants, and initial conditions. The verifier checks numerical answers with tolerance (1e-6), validates eigenvalue analysis for stability, and confirms bifurcation parameter ranges. The decomposition splits into 4 sub-agents: one computes equilibria, one analyzes local stability, one maps bifurcations, and one synthesizes the phase portrait. Oracle scores 1.0, single-agent scores 0.25, multi-agent scores 0.80.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 8 hours per day with a 4-hour overlap with PST.
  • Employment Type: Contractor position (Note: this role does not include medical/paid leave).
  • Duration of Contract: 6months (expected start date is next week).


How to Apply?

Please send us your updated CV to with job ID 75046 in the email subject line.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (TypeScript + React)
description:
Role Overview: Own full-stack product end-to-end. Lead Product engineering role with strong ownership, full direct communication with the client and AI workflows.

Experience Level: 7+ years

Location: Remote

Tech Stack: TypeScript + React, Prisma, Fastify, Mantine

Contract Type: Full-time, B2B contract


About the Role

Radity  is a global software engineering company delivering innovative digital solutions to clients around the world. We are passionate about building great technology and fostering a collaborative environment where people grow, take ownership, and make a real impact.


Our client is a US insurance company, subsidiary of Fortune 500 companies. This is an “insurance startup” with an agile culture and approach to work, and future oriented approach to technology. Product is internally developed Claims Management system. The product is in the early development stage. Once MVP goes live, project will continue to stabilize the product and enhance it with new features and AI -powered workflows embedded directly into real business processes.


Radity is running software development projects with the client for more than 3 years. This is not an outsourcing role, but a real product engineering role, where you will be part of a big joint Radity and Client team. Engineers are trusted with context, real problems, and responsibility for delivering outcomes.


You’ll work closely with product managers, designers, and sometimes clients to design, build, and evolve a complex platform used by insurance professionals every day.


What You’ll Do

  • Own features end to end — from understanding the business problem to solution design, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Design and build backend services using TypeScript, Prisma and Fastify
  • Develop modern frontend features using React and TypeScript
  • Work with PostgreSQL
  • Contribute to the evolution of the platform architecture and technical standards
  • Build and integrate AI-powered workflows that support complex claims management business flows, using existing AI services and tooling where appropriate
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to shape solutions, not just implement requirements
  • Take responsibility for testing, CI/CD, releases, and production readiness
  • Continuously improve performance, reliability, observability, and developer experience
  • Use modern AI-assisted coding tools as part of daily engineering work


What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of professional experience as a software engineer
  • Strong hands-on experience with TypeScript + React, Prisma
  • Experience building and operating real production systems (not just isolated components)
  • Solid understanding of system design, architecture, and trade-offs
  • Comfort working with incomplete requirements and asking the right questions
  • Experience with Azure or similar cloud platforms
  • Practical experience with CI/CD, automated testing, and deployments
  • Product-oriented mindset — focus on user value and business outcomes
  • Active, practical use of AI tools in daily development
  • Experience in client-facing or stakeholder discussions
  • Upper-Intermediate English or higher


Nice to have (not required)

  • Insurtech background


Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive market-level compensation based on experience and location
  • Generous vacation policy
  • Full equipment provided
  • Paid access to modern AI tools, learning resources, and subscriptions
  • Support for continuous learning and professional development
  • Strong engineering culture with high trust and autonomy


Why This Role

  • High ownership and real influence on product direction
  • Engineers are trusted to think, design, and decide, not just execute
  • Direct Exposure to the top engineering team
  • AI is a real working tool and part of the product, not a buzzword
  • Long-term product vision with solid business fundamentals


Recruitment process

  • Recruiter Screen: short intro call to align on experience, mindset, location, and compensation
  • Hiring Manager Interview: product- and case-focused discussion with an Engineering Manager (no take-home task)
  • Interview with the Client’s CTO
  • Offer

description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Full Stack Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.

Mandatory Skills:

  • Advanced or fluent English is mandatory;
  • The professional must be comfortable participating in daily meetings, technical discussions, and written communication in English;
  • Strong hands-on experience with React, Next.js, and TypeScript;
  • Experience building modern web applications with reusable component-based architectures;
  • Experience with styling solutions in React, preferably styled-components;
  • Strong experience with Node.js and Next.js API routes for backend-for-frontend or API integration layers;
  • Experience integrating with external APIs and working with API gateway/proxy solutions such as Apigee or AWS API Gateway;
  • Experience with AWS cloud services, especially serverless solutions such as Lambda;
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and delivery workflows, preferably with Jenkins;
  • Experience working with Git in collaborative development environments;
  • Experience with observability and monitoring tools, preferably New Relic;
  • Experience writing unit and integration tests using tools such as Jest, Vitest, Mocha, or React Testing Library;
  • Experience working with Jira and Confluence;

Desirable Skills:

  • Experience with Content Management Systems (e.g. Content Stack, Drupal, Payload CMS);
  • Experience integrating or developing AI-enabled solutions;
  • Experience with Tailwind CSS;
  • Experience with Figma and collaboration with design teams using prototypes;
  • Experience with database services such as PostgreSQL and Databricks;
  • Experience with performance optimization, production support, and troubleshooting in cloud environments;

Responsabilities:

We are looking for a Full Stack Expert developer, self-driven, and self-learning professional to support critical automation initiatives within the Defense Center, with a strong focus on incident automation, workflow orchestration, and Jira backend enablement.

This role requires a unique combination of technical depth and process thinking. The individual must be able to design and implement automation end-to-end, translating complex operational needs into scalable solutions that reduce manual effort and improve response efficiency.

Given the nature of the work — highly integrated, security‑sensitive, and operationally critical — we need someone who can operate with high autonomy, quickly learn the environment, and continuously evolve the solution without heavy supervision or external dependency.

title: Operador de Máquinas Pesadas
description:
Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Operar máquinas pesadas para abastecimento de biomassa no fundo móvel e organização de materiais no galpão;
  • Movimentação e organização de cinzas;
  • Movimentação e organização de resíduos industriais;
  • Realizar inspeções diárias no equipamento, verificando condições operacionais, níveis de óleo, água, pneus e demais componentes;
  • Preencher checklists e relatórios de operação quando necessário;
  • Reportar ao coordenador, supervisor ou operador de painel qualquer anormalidade identificada durante a operação;
  • Executar manobras seguras e eficientes, respeitando os limites operacionais e as sinalizações da área;
  • Contribuir com as iniciativas de melhoria contínua da área;
  • Prevenir, monitorar e mitigar impactos ambientais durante a operação;
  • Manter o equipamento limpo e organizado, zelando pela conservação e bom uso;
  • Efetuar registros operacionais conforme os sistemas e procedimentos definidos;
  • Participar das elaborações das APR´s para serviços críticos;
  • Realizar outras atividades correlatas às descritas acima, compatível com a sua condição pessoal e conforme solicitado pelo seu superior imediato.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Curso de Operador de Máquinas Pesadas;
  • CNH categoria B;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em regime de turno e escala;
  • Conhecimento de normas de segurança (APR / PTA / PET / DDS) e em rotinas de manutenção preventiva e corretiva de equipamentos móveis;
  • Conhecimento em operação segura de pá carregadeira;
  • CNH categoria C ou superior e experiência em operação de pá carregadeira será considerado um diferencial;
  • Desejável conhecimento em métodos de análise e solução de problemas (MASP).


Aviso Legal:

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.


Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.


Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Video Editor – Part-Time, Remote (UGC, Beauty/Skincare)
description:
Hours: 20 hours/week

Location: Remote


About Wildfleur

Wildfleur is a fast-growing beauty brand now in over 600 Ulta Beauty stores nationwide within our first months on the market. We’ve earned multiple press mentions and industry awards, including Byrdie’s Best Vitamin C.


Role Overview

The Video Editor will produce short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram and paid ads that are engaging, trend-aware, and aligned with our brand. This role is ideal for someone who loves skincare and beauty, lives in social media culture, and knows how to turn raw footage into polished content that connects with our audience.


Key Responsibilities

  • Transform UGC, influencer clips, and brand shoots into ads that feel authentic, on-trend, and true to our brand identity.
  • Edit raw footage into short, engaging TikTok and Instagram videos.
  • Use eye-catching edits: clean transitions, quick cuts, trending sounds, and storytelling hooks.
  • Add captions, text overlays, music, and effects while keeping the skincare/beauty audience in mind.
  • Ensure videos are exported in the correct formats, resolutions, and aspect ratios for each platform (TikTok, Instagram, Reels, Stories, and paid ads).
  • Stay on top of TikTok & Instagram trends.
  • Keep video assets organized and workflows smooth for ongoing projects.


Qualifications

  • 2–3+ years of experience in video editing, with a strong portfolio of short-form content.
  • Proven track record of creating high-converting paid social media ads and working extensively with UGC.
  • Portfolio examples in beauty, skincare, or cosmetics content are preferred - you understand the audience and the aesthetics.
  • Fluent in English, both spoken and written, for seamless communication and creating platform-native captions.
  • Passionate about cosmetics/skincare culture - you enjoy this world and bring genuine interest into the content.
  • Experience editing with Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects.
  • Comfortable working in CapCut or mobile-friendly apps when quick, social-native edits are needed.
  • Up-to-date with social media culture, trends, hooks, and viral formats.
  • Strong technical knowledge of video requirements for social media (aspect ratios, frame rates, resolutions, file sizes, export settings).
  • Highly detail-oriented, delivering content that is both on-trend and brand-consistent.
  • A degree in a creative field (film, media, communications, design) or background in filming/content creation is a plus (not required).


Perks

  • Flexible remote schedule.
  • Be part of a supportive and creative team

title: English Language Teaching (ELT) Materials Editor (Remote | Full-time)
description:
Role Description

This is a remote position for a full-time English Language Teaching (ELT) Materials Editor. The primary responsibilities include developing and editing ELT materials, aligning content with curriculum goals, and ensuring the materials meet high-quality standards. The role involves lesson planning, reviewing instructional design, and collaborating with educators to refine content for various language-learning levels.


Qualifications

  • Expertise in Lesson Planning and Curriculum Development to create effective and engaging learning materials
  • Strong skills in Education and Teaching with a focus on English language instruction
  • Excellent Communication skills to collaborate with team members, educators, and stakeholders
  • Attention to detail, with the ability to perform thorough reviews and quality checks on instructional materials
  • Familiarity with current trends in ELT methodologies and instructional design
  • Bachelor’s degree in Education, English, Linguistics, or a related field; advanced degrees are a plus
  • Experience working with remote teams or creating materials for digital learning platforms is an advantage

title: Wordpress Developer
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop custom WordPress plugins and themes from scratch using PHP, MySQL, and modern best practices.
  • Implement advanced custom fields (ACF) , custom post types , and taxonomies for structured data management.
  • Optimize database queries and improve performance across complex WordPress sites (meta queries, caching, indexing).
  • Integrate WordPress with third-party APIs and automation tools (REST, webhook systems, Make/Zapier, Algolia, etc.).
  • Develop and maintain cron jobs , background tasks, and data synchronization scripts.
  • Build and maintain Gutenberg blocks or React-based admin components when required.
  • Ensure sites meet performance, accessibility, and SEO standards (Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (frontend, DevOps, QA, design) following Agile practices.
  • Write clean, well-documented, and unit-tested code following OOP principles and WordPress coding standards.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience , focusing on backend and custom plugin work.
  • Strong proficiency in PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript .
  • Experience with WordPress hooks (actions & filters) , custom queries, and optimization strategies.
  • Proficient in ACF , CPT UI , Gutenberg , and WooCommerce .
  • Solid understanding of WordPress REST API , webhooks , and API integrations .
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines .
  • Experience with performance optimization , caching mechanisms, and scalable WordPress architectures.
  • Advanced written and spoken English (international client communication required).


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

Experiência em criação, gestão e otimização de campanhas de mídia paga (Mercado Ads, Amazon Ads e Shopee Ads), com foco em melhoria de ACOS, ROAS e conversão. Forte atuação em inteligência comercial, análise de concorrência, definição de preços estratégicos considerando taxas, impostos e margens, além da identificação de oportunidades de mercado.


Vivência em gestão de catálogo e SEO para anúncios, com cadastro de produtos otimizados, criação de kits/bundles e melhoria de performance orgânica. Conhecimento em integração operacional via ERP e hubs como Bling, Tiny, Anymarket e Plugg.to, garantindo sincronização de estoque, pedidos, preços e faturamento.


Experiência em logística para marketplaces, incluindo gestão de modalidades Full, Flex, coleta e agências, controle de estoque em CDs e planejamento de reabastecimento.


Perfil analítico, proativo, organizado e orientado a resultados, com capacidade de gerir múltiplos canais simultaneamente e resolver problemas com autonomia.

title: Analista Financeiro Pleno
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Analista de Financeiro Pleno , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time Financeiro e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de contas a pagar e receber, incluindo execução de pagamentos;
  • Realização de conciliações bancárias, garantindo a acuracidade das informações;
  • Atualização e controle do fluxo de caixa, assegurando o correto registro das movimentações financeiras;
  • Execução de rotinas financeiras recorrentes com alto volume de transações e prazos definidos;
  • Organização e arquivamento de documentos financeiros e fiscais;
  • Execução e suporte no processo de faturamento e emissão de notas fiscais, incluindo tratamento de inconsistências;
  • Execução de rotinas administrativas e compras corporativas;
  • Gestão e controle de contratos;
  • Execução e suporte ativo no fechamento contábil, com envio de informações e realização de conciliações financeiras;
  • Execução de validações e suporte às auditorias financeiras;
  • Interface com áreas internas e fornecedores para resolução de pendências financeiras;
  • Identificação, análise e resolução de inconsistências financeiras, com proposição de melhorias;
  • Garantir a execução ponta a ponta das rotinas financeiras sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Garantir a qualidade, consistência e confiabilidade das informações financeiras.


Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida com rotinas financeiras e administrativas (conciliação, controle e análise de dados);
  • Conhecimento em relatórios financeiros e controles internos;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel/Google Sheets;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Power BI;
  • Boa comunicação, organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Perfil proativo, analítico, com boa gestão do tempo e trabalho em equipe.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com ERP financeiro (ex: Omie, Conta Azul, SAP, etc.);
  • Experiência construindo dashboards financeiros;
  • Conhecimento básico sobre tributos;
  • Vivência em empresas de alto crescimento ou startups;
  • Experiência prévia com processos de fechamento contábil e auditoria;
  • Experiência com melhoria contínua e otimização de processos financeiros.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.


O que oferecemos:

title: Especialista em Licitações, Propostas e Acordos Comerciais
description:
Líder mundial em Recursos Humanos, a Adecco está presente em 60 países, por meio de uma rede de 5.500 delegações que diariamente proporcionam emprego a 700.000 pessoas e prestam serviços a mais de 100.000 empresas. Faz parte da Fortune Global 500 e está cotada na bolsa de Zurique. A Adecco possui uma estrutura global orientada para a oferta de soluções integradas em Recursos Humanos, com o compromisso de desenvolver continuamente serviços eficazes e competitivos para seus clientes.


Assessoramos importante empresa internacional de BPO.


O Bids, Proposals & Commercial Agreements Specialist será responsável por gerenciar e executar processos comerciais estruturados , garantindo a elaboração de propostas claras, consistentes e competitivas para clientes globais.

Este profissional atuará como um ponto central de organização e coordenação entre as áreas comercial, técnica e operacional, assegurando qualidade, aderência aos requisitos do cliente e cumprimento rigoroso de prazos.


Principais Responsabilidades

Gestão de Bids e Propostas Comerciais

  • Coordenar processos de RFI, RFQ e RFP
  • Preparar, revisar e consolidar propostas comerciais
  • Garantir alinhamento entre solução proposta, escopo e termos comerciais


Acordos Comerciais e Documentação

  • Apoiar na elaboração e organização de:
  • Contratos comerciais
  • MSA (Master Service Agreement)
  • SOW (Statement of Work)
  • SLAs e KPIs
  • Garantir clareza, consistência e padronização da documentação


Coordenação Multidisciplinar

  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com:
  • Time comercial
  • Pré-vendas / Solutions
  • Operações

title: BDR (Business Development Representative)
description:
About Foundey

Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting SaaS, AI, and tech startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with founders to deliver high-impact design solutions—from MVP design sprints to full-scale product interface design and UX audits.


The Opportunity

We’re looking for a proactive, hands on and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand Foundey’s pipeline of high-quality startup clients. In this role, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers—primarily founders and decision-makers in SaaS, AI, and tech companies.

You’ll play a critical role in connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys building relationships from the ground up.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and research potential clients within SaaS, AI, and tech startup ecosystems
  • Conduct outbound prospecting via email, LinkedIn, and other channels
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads to assess fit and readiness
  • Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities
  • Collaborate with marketing and design teams to refine outreach messaging
  • Track activities and performance using CRM tools
  • Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback


Qualifications

  • 3 years+ of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in SaaS or agency environments)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in written outreach
  • Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce)
  • Ability to understand and communicate design, product, or tech-related concepts
  • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely
  • English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus)


Nice to Have

  • Experience selling design, product, or digital services
  • Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development
  • Experience working with early-stage startups or founders


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Content Safety Operations Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Content Safety Operations Specialist to support the Brazil market, ensuring high standards of content quality and safety across the platform. In this role, you will monitor content trends, identify risks, and collaborate closely with global teams to improve policies and enforcement strategies.


You will act as a key local point of contact, bringing insights about Brazilian culture, user behavior, and regulatory developments to support the continuous evolution of content safety operations.

  • Continuously review and assess content quality and appropriateness within the Brazil market, identifying risks, anomalies, and emerging trends.
  • Produce regular reports on content quality, trending topics, and potential safety risks.
  • Act as the local point of contact for safety operations, maintaining close communication with global teams.
  • Share insights on local culture, user behavior, and policy updates to support decision-making.
  • Support the development and optimization of content safety strategies and moderation guidelines tailored to the Brazil market.
  • Monitor regulatory developments related to online content in Brazil and support the handling of escalations and compliance requirements.


Requirements

  • Fluent Portuguese and Chinese (Mandarin) to support communication with global stakeholders.
  • 2+ years of experience in content safety, content moderation, Trust & Safety, or related fields.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian culture, social trends, and online behavior, with the ability to identify sensitive content.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working in distributed or international teams.


Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of English (written and spoken), with the ability to collaborate with global teams.
  • Experience working with policy development, moderation guidelines, or regulatory compliance.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

description:

SOBRE A SPELAION:

A Spelaion é a representante oficial e exclusiva da Petzl no Brasil, sendo uma das principais referências nacionais no segmento de equipamentos para altura (esportivo ou profissional) e iluminação de cabeça. Além de fornecer soluções em segurança e iluminação, a Spelaion atua na capacitação por meio de treinamentos e consultorias em diversos países em quatro continentes.


Fundada em 2005, a empresa se destaca pelo compromisso contínuo com a segurança, a qualidade e a excelência, consolidando sua posição como referência no mercado nacional e com reconhecimento internacional.

Na Spelaion buscamos pessoas que se desafiam e que queiram gerar impactos positivos todos os dias na sociedade. Impulsionamos e apoiamos os colaboradores que queiram se desenvolver e aprender dia a dia, dando oportunidade de crescimento pessoal e profissional.


A Vaga é presencial, portanto o profissional deve residir em Piracicaba, SP.


Principais atividades:

  •  Conciliação bancária;
  • Fazer a interface com instituições financeiras;

Para essa posição é necessário:

  • Conhecimento intermediário no pacote office (Excel e Word);
  • Dinamismo e proatividade.


Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Conhecimento na área de atividade da Spelaion;
  • Conhecimento fiscal;
  • Facilidade de relacionamento;
  • Inglês e/ou Espanhol nível intermediário a avançado.

44h semanais de 2ª a 6ª feira


Benefícios:

  • Vale alimentação
  • Convênio com instituições de ensino
  • Assistência Médica 
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Convênio com farmácias
  • Convênio com Sesc
  • Convênio com ACIPI
  • Seguro de vida
  • Vale transporte

title: UX/UI pleno
description:
olá, UX/UI pleno !


somos a teceo, a plataforma unificada de comércio B2B que conecta marcas e lojistas, a qualquer hora, de qualquer lugar. uma empresa jovem com um sonho grande: transformar o atacado da moda brasileira.


o designer ux/ui pleno aqui não é só quem entrega telas bonitas. a vaga exige alguém que leia requisitos, entenda regras de negócio e de sistema, detalhe fluxos e estados com precisão e garanta que o que foi desenhado é o que vai ser implementado, desde o alinhamento com devs e qa até o design review. discovery com clientes, gestão de demandas da squad e changelog semanal também fazem parte da rotina.


estamos em busca de uma pessoa analítica, que goste de entender o problema antes de abrir o figma, que tenha atenção a detalhe e consiga transitar entre a camada visual e a camada lógica do produto sem abrir mão da qualidade.


para fazer parte do time, buscamos pessoas que queiram se arriscar, sair da zona de conforto e transformar o mercado junto com a gente!


o que você vai fazer:

  • representar a visão de produto dentro da squad
  • criar e evoluir interfaces digitais (web e mobile) 
  • detalhar fluxos, estados e documentações de design e negócio
  • garantir padronização visual (design system)
  • analisar requisitos, regras de negócio e regras de sistema
  • garantir alinhamento contínuo com desenvolvedores e qa da squad
  • realizar design review e testes básicos de qualidade
  • gerenciar e priorizar demandas da squad em conjunto com o tech lead
  • conduzir discovery com clientes quando necessário
  • preparar materiais para o changelog semanalmente


o que procuramos em você:

  • forte senso estético alinhado à identidade da teceo
  • interesse por tendências em design para sugerir inovação
  • alta capacidade em figma
  • uso frequente de IA no dia a dia de trabalho (desejável)
  • atenção e cuidado aos detalhes em todas as tarefas
  • curiosidade e interesse pelo produto para aprender regras rapidamente
  • capacidade de sugerir soluções e tomar decisões
  • comunicação clara e colaboração com diferentes áreas
  • proatividade e capacidade de aprender e se adaptar rapidamente
  • conhecimento em princípios de UX/UI
  • experiência profissional mínima de 3 anos


o que oferecemos:

  • remuneração de R$ 6k a R$ 9k
  • modelo de contratação PJ
  • programa de SOP
  • distribuição semestral de lucros
  • cartão Swile e TotalPass
  • formato home-office
  • horário & descanso flexíveis
  • bootcamp-teceo ~ imersão presencial anual com o time
  • fio-da-meada ~ rumos & números do negócio em uma reunião trimestral
  • eventos diversos ~ happy hours, learning days, torneios de jogos etc.


nenhum bom negócio é feito sozinho. quer entrar pro time? fale com a gente!

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Junior AI Agent Engineer (Part-Time, can transition to Full-Time) | Remote, Brazil
description:
AlphaCorp AI |


We're hiring a Junior AI Agent Engineer to join our team building production AI systems. This is a part-time role with a path to full-time for the right person. Students and early-career engineers are welcome.


What you'll work on


We work across the full AI engineering stack:

  • Software Engineering
  • AI Agent Engineering
  • RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Development
  • Prompt Engineering
  • Fine-Tuning
  • DevOps / MLOps


You'll get hands-on exposure to real systems and real problems.


What we're looking for


  • Basic spoken and written English (you'll read docs and communicate with the team)
  • Some Python experience (university coursework counts)
  • Basic understanding of AI and LLMs
  • Comfortable using an AI dev tool like Claude Code or Cursor in your daily workflow
  • Curiosity, ownership, and a willingness to learn fast


Students can apply. We care more about how you think than what's on your résumé.


How we work

  • 100% remote, anywhere in Brazil
  • Flexible working hours
  • Daily standups to stay aligned
  • Lean team, low bureaucracy, fast iteration


Compensation

  • R$ 2.000 base (gross, CLT)
  • Performance bonus of R$ 500 to R$ 2.000 per month, calculated monthly based on hours worked
  • Part-time now, with a clear transition path to full-time


Hiring process


  • A quick 30-minute intro call with the founder, in English, to get to know each other.
  • A take-home task.
  • A 1-hour follow-up call with one of our engineers, in Portuguese, to walk through how you solved the task and answer a few extra questions.


Using AI tools during the take-home is welcome and encouraged. Bad code is not.


How to apply


Send us a short message about yourself, attach your resume, anything you've built (small projects, hackathons, or coursework all count), and how you've been using AI tools in your own work. Links to GitHub, demos, or write-ups are a plus.

title: Python Developer
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de um Python Developer para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas brasileiros. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

  • Identificar e resolver problemas de desempenho e escalabilidade com crawling distribuído em escala.

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de CI/CD utilizando github actions;
  • Experiência em times de desenvolvimento de software ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados e ferramentas de integração contínua;
  • Conhecimento de Design Patterns;

Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível de benefícios;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;

  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.

title: Analista de Meta Ads
description:
ANALISTA DE META ADS


Cargo: Analista de Meta Ads 

Empresa: C7 Auto

Modalidade: Trabalho remoto

Remuneração: a depender da experiência


A C7 Auto está em busca de um Analista de Meta Ads que possua amplo conhecimento em gerenciamento de campanhas de Marketing Digital em Facebook/Instagram Ads, orientado a dados (Data Driven) e de um profissional com experiência em criar estratégias, executar e analisar métricas.


  • Trabalho remoto.
  • Oportunidade de atuar em uma empresa em crescimento.
  • Participação em um projeto estratégico de campanhas em Meta Ads.


Para se candidatar, leia com MUITA ATENÇÃO a descrição da vaga.


Responsabilidades:


  • Planejar, criar, gerenciar e otimizar campanhas de Meta Ads (Facebook e Instagram), com foco em geração de leads qualificados e alta performance.
  • Desenvolver estratégias orientadas a dados para alcançar resultados escaláveis e previsíveis.
  • Monitorar e analisar métricas críticas, como CTR, CPA e ROI, propondo ajustes em tempo real para maximizar eficiência e conversão.
  • Colaborar com os times de design e conteúdo para criar campanhas impactantes e alinhadas ao funil de vendas dos clientes.
  • Garantir a integração das campanhas com ferramentas de CRM e outras plataformas, promovendo uma experiência fluida e personalizada para os leads.
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico dos clientes, alinhando expectativas e apresentando resultados de forma clara e objetiva.


Requisitos:


  • Formação: Comunicação, Marketing, Publicidade, Propaganda, Jornalismo ou experiência equivalente comprovada.
  • Entender de copy;
  • Experiência avançada em gestão de campanhas on-line no Meta Ads (Facebook e Instagram);
  • Trabalhar na otimização constante dos canais de aquisição de leads;
  • Habilidade relacional com colegas de trabalho e clientes;
  • Habilidade para orientações para criação das peças junto ao designer (briefing).


Características desejáveis que vão destacar sua candidatura:


  • Conhecimento e aplicação de criativos orientados a dados (Data Driven Marketing);
  • Formação superior, MBA/Pós-graduação em Publicidade, Propaganda, Marketing ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Facebook Ads e Remarketing;
  • Conhecimento básico em Google Tag Manager;
  • Gosto por estudar e se aprimorar na área de marketing pago no Facebook e Instagram
  • Cursos de marketing (Goobec, BSM - Brasília Marketing School, 8Ps, Digitalks, Cursos On-line, etc);
  • Criatividade para elaborar conteúdo para internet.


Na C7 Auto funciona assim:


  • Nosso horário: das 9h às 19h, com 1h de almoço;
  • Nas sextas-feiras, atuamos até 18h, com 1h de almoço;
  • Não atuamos aos sábados e domingos;
  • Temos 34 dias de recesso por ano, e folga no dia do aniversário;
  • Temos parceria com a StarBem, um aplicativo de saúde que oferece consultas médicas, terapia, entre outros, para os nossos prestadores;
  • Somos uma empresa 100% trabalho remoto: você prestará seu serviço de onde desejar, desde que assegure sua plena atenção às demandas e a conexão com a internet na qualidade requerida para desempenhar as atividades durante o horário de prestação de serviços;
  • Nosso modelo de Contrato é de Prestação de Serviços (PJ): infraestrutura e equipamentos de informática e telefonia serão de responsabilidade da empresa contratada.


Se você é apaixonado por ajudar clientes a alcançarem seus objetivos, tem um perfil analítico e gosta de atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e inovador, a C7 Auto é o lugar certo para você! 

Inscreva-se e contribua para o sucesso dos nossos clientes!

description:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Requirements:

  • Strong English communication skills (written and spoken).
  • Computer with 16 GB RAM or more (mandatory).

Benefits:

title: Data Scientist – Quant
description:
Data Scientist Sênior – Quant (Quantitative Researcher | Alpha & Investment Strategies)

Se você já pensa como um investidor quantitativo e não precisa “aprender finanças no trabalho”, essa oportunidade é para você.

Você atuará na interseção entre rigor estatístico e tomada de decisão em investimentos, sendo responsável por pesquisar, validar e colocar em produção sinais que geram retorno real. Aqui, nenhuma ideia vai para produção sem validação profunda.


Sobre o papel

Você será responsável por desenvolver e evoluir estratégias quantitativas, desde a pesquisa até a aplicação em produção, garantindo robustez estatística, escalabilidade e impacto direto em decisões de investimento.


Conhecimento em Finanças (não negociável)

• Factor investing: value, momentum, quality, low volatility, carry

• Construção de portfólio: mean-variance, risk budgeting, Black-Litterman

• Modelos de risco: covariância (Ledoit-Wolf, RMT), VaR, CVaR, stress testing

• Backtesting avançado: walk-forward, regime analysis, overfitting, Sharpe ajustado, PBO

• Microestrutura de mercado: bid-ask, market impact, execution alpha

• Derivativos: Greeks, vol surface, estrutura a termo (nível prático)


Requisitos técnicos

• Mestrado ou PhD em área quantitativa (Estatística, Matemática, Física, Engenharia, CS)

• +3 anos em research quantitativo (hedge fund, asset ou prop desk)

• Python avançado: numpy, pandas, scipy, statsmodels, scikit-learn

• Forte base em estatística: séries temporais, testes de hipótese, múltiplos testes

• Experiência com modelos fatoriais (Barra, Axioma ou próprios)

• Entendimento de execução e impacto de mercado

• Inglês fluênte


Diferenciais

• Publicações acadêmicas

• Track record de estratégias em produção

• Experiência com large-scale data e otimização de portfólio


Atuação: 100% remota

Contratação: PJ

title: Engineering Design Specialist - 72123
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals.
  • Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance.


Domain Tracks:

You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g; expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus.

  • Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems.
  • Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design.
  • Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry.
  • Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification.
  • Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design.
  • Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference.
  • Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads.
  • Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design.
  • Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design.
  • Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration.
  • Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis).
  • Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain.
  • Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills.
  • High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

Digital Experience Engineering Manager

Brazil/Argentina (Remote)

Long Term Contract

If you are excited to make a difference applying cutting-edge technologies to solve real business challenges and add value to a global, market-leading organization, please come join us!

External: Marketing Agencies, Third Party Providers.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of developers and web technology professionals, fostering a high-performance culture.
  • Oversee the design, development, and deployment of high-quality, scalable web solutions that align with business strategies and goals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with UX/UI designers, product managers, QA teams, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and delivery of web projects.
  • Implement and enforce best practices in software development, including code quality, performance optimization, and security measures.
  • Drive the adoption of modern technologies and methodologies to enhance the team's capabilities and deliver innovative solutions.
  • Manage timelines, resources, and budgets, ensuring that all initiatives are completed on time and within scope.
  • Lead the strategy for web and digital technology, aligning with organizational goals and driving digital transformation.
  • Stay current with emerging technology trends and integrate relevant advancements into the team's work.
  • Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement, encouraging the team to stay ahead of industry trends and technological advancements.
  • Ensure that all development and web solutions comply with relevant data privacy regulations such as CPRA/CCPA, GDPR, and other global privacy standards.
  • Implement mechanisms for handling user consent, managing data access controls, and ensuring that all data collection practices align with legal requirements.
  • Act as a point of escalation for technical issues, providing solutions and guiding the team through complex challenges.
  • Collaborate with other engineering managers and leaders to align on technical strategies and share best practices.
  • Report on progress, team performance, and technological advancements to senior leadership.
  • Lead the team's efforts in troubleshooting and resolving issues, ensuring minimal disruption to project timelines.


Required Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in information technology leading remote, global teams across time zones and a minimum of 5 years of experience in product or engineering management.
  • 8+ years of experience and deep understanding of digital marketing technologies is required, specifically in web development.
  • Strong expertise in Sitecore CMS and other web technologies with experience in building, delivering, and operating digital platforms
  • Technical leadership experience with solution architecture, software development, engineering management, and application delivery, including CICD, SDLC, and MACH architecture practices
  • Proven track record in leading and delivering complex digital projects.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire and guide a team.
  • Deep understanding of Agile methodologies and project management tools.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make strategic decisions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong knowledge of data privacy regulations like CPRA/CCPA, GDPR, and their implications for web development.
  • Experience implementing data protection mechanisms, including consent management, data encryption, and access controls.
  • Familiarity with One Trust or similar systems privacy and compliance features, including the ability to configure and enforce data protection settings.
  • Proven ability and experience in building highly skilled product teams and mentoring a team of developers.
  • Strong sense of urgency in delivering results and high cross-cultural awareness and sensitivity.
  • Operate as a change agent at multiple levels of an organization with outstanding organizational, communication, interpersonal, relationship-building skills conducive to collaboration at all levels.

title: Gerente de Produto Sr.
description:
Gerente de Produto Sr.

Home Office | PJ


Você será responsável pela visão de produto das ferramentas internas que gestores de portfólio, analistas quantitativos e traders utilizam diariamente. Não se trata de gestão de produtos para o consumidor final — seus usuários gerenciam bilhões e não têm paciência para softwares que os atrasem.

\"Um ótimo gestor de portfólio aqui não precisa ser um analista quantitativo. Mas precisa pensar como um investidor e falar a linguagem fluente do mercado financeiro — ou nossos usuários jamais confiarão nele.\"

\"Um ótimo gestor de portfólio aqui não precisa ser um analista quantitativo. Mas precisa pensar como um investidor e falar a linguagem fluente do mercado financeiro — ou nossos usuários jamais confiarão nele.\"


\" Conhecimento da área financeira é imprescindível — não negociável

- Fluxo de trabalho de investimento: Geração de ideias → pesquisa → construção de portfólio → execução → monitoramento → relatórios

- Gestão de portfólio: Ações long/short, multiestratégia, estruturas de alocação, lógica de rebalanceamento, gestão de drawdown

- Risco e conformidade: Limites de posição, risco de concentração, relatórios regulatórios (13F, AIFMD), padrões de relatórios para investidores

- Operações de negociação: Sistemas OMS/EMS, fundamentos do protocolo FIX, verificações de conformidade pré-negociação, alocação de negociações

- Atribuição de desempenho: Atribuição Brinson, decomposição de fatores, relatórios de retorno relativo ao benchmark versus retorno absoluto

- Relações com investidores: Relatórios para LPs, fluxos de trabalho DDQ, fundamentos de contabilidade de fundos, processos de chamada de capital/distribuição


Habilidades

- Mais de 5 anos de experiência em gestão de produtos — com pelo menos 3 anos em serviços financeiros, gestão de ativos ou fintech atendendo clientes institucionais

- Você já desenvolveu produtos para investidores profissionais, traders ou gestores de portfólio — não para o varejo

- Capacidade de ler e discutir um relatório de atribuição de fatores Análise detalhada de lucros e perdas ou resumo da exposição ao risco sem glossário

- Experiência com fornecedores de OMS/EMS (Charles River, Advent, Eze ou equivalentes)

- Capacidade comprovada de gerenciar roteiros em ambientes altamente regulamentados e sujeitos a auditorias

- Forte intuição para dados — você consegue escrever SQL e consultar um modelo de dados de forma independente

- MBA ou CFA são um diferencial; experiência comprovada na área é mais importante

title: Analista de desenvolvimento
description:
Faça parte da transformação na Mosten

Na Mosten, transformamos desafios reais em soluções inteligentes e eficazes. Somos uma consultoria com 11 anos de história, atuando no Brasil e em Portugal, entregando soluções sob medida com foco em resultado, eficiência e evolução contínua.

A atuação será técnica e consultiva , exigindo forte capacidade de análise, autonomia e visão crítica para propor melhorias, apoiar integrações e atuar na resolução de demandas complexas. • Garantir qualidade, performance e confiabilidade nas soluções desenvolvidas


Requisitos

• Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software em nível sênior

• Conhecimento e atuação com NAVIS N4

• Experiência com Java

• Capacidade de atuar com autonomia em demandas técnicas de maior complexidade

Você será responsável por mapear o mercado, gerar listas qualificadas e atuar em parceria com os recrutadores, garantindo uma experiência de candidato fluida e processos mais assertivos.


Você será responsável por:

  • Apoiar o time na busca de profissionais para vagas de tecnologia (Desenvolvimento, QA, DevOps, Data, etc.);
  • Realizar pesquisas de perfis em plataformas como LinkedIn;
  • Ajudar na organização de listas de candidatos e pipelines;
  • Apoiar no contato inicial com candidatos, apresentando oportunidades;
  • Atualizar informações em sistemas internos (ATS);
  • Trabalhar junto com recrutadores para entender os perfis das vagas;
  • Apoiar atividades gerais do time de Talent Acquisition.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência inicial com recrutamento e seleção de candidatos;
  • Interesse em aprender sobre recrutamento e tecnologia;
  • Boa organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Boa comunicação escrita;
  • Proatividade e vontade de aprender no dia a dia;


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios):

  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas ATS.
  • Interesse por tecnologia ou já ter tido contato com a área;


A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Analista de negócios sênior
description:
Vaga: Analista de Negócio Sênior – Value Creation

Atuação: 100% home office (com idas esporádicas ao cliente) - Ribeirão Preto/SP

Contratação: PJ sem benefícios

Projeto: Tempo indeterminado


Buscamos por um(a) Analista de Negócio Sênior, para atuar de forma estratégica conectando negócio, dados e tecnologia, garantindo a geração de valor por meio de iniciativas com resultados mensuráveis, como aumento de receita, redução de custos e ganho de eficiência.


Responsabilidades:

• Mapear o contexto de negócio (AS IS) e desenhar cenários futuros (TO BE) com foco em geração de valor

• Identificar oportunidades estratégicas de melhoria, inovação e otimização de processos

• Construir e sustentar business cases (ROI, TCO, payback)

• Definir e acompanhar KPIs e OKRs das iniciativas

• Priorizar demandas com base em impacto x esforço

• Atuar como interface entre áreas de negócio, tecnologia e stakeholders executivos

• Conduzir workshops de discovery e levantamento de requisitos

• Garantir rastreabilidade de valor ao longo dos projetos

• Apoiar squads ágeis ou projetos tradicionais com foco em entregas orientadas a valor

• Produzir materiais executivos para tomada de decisão


Requisitos obrigatórios:

• Experiência sólida como Analista de Negócio com foco em geração de valor

• Vivência em consultorias ou projetos de grande porte

• Experiência na construção de business cases e análise financeira (ROI, TCO, indicadores)

• Experiência em transformação digital e melhoria de processos

• Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e/ou tradicionais (PMI)

• Domínio em levantamento de requisitos e modelagem de processos (BPMN)

• Experiência com ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau ou similares)

• Boa comunicação e gestão de stakeholders

title: Representante comercial de vendas
description:
Representante Comercial — Energia Solar Corporativa | SC, PR e RS


A StartSun Energia Solar está expandindo o time comercial no Sul do Brasil.


Buscamos 10 Representantes Comerciais para atuar em SC, PR e RS no

mercado de energia solar fotovoltaica — um dos setores que mais cresce

no país, com tickets que vão de R$ 30 mil a R$ 3 milhões.


Atuamos desde 2017 com projetos residenciais, comerciais, industriais e

usinas em solo. Agora, ampliamos a operação para atender o mercado

corporativo (indústrias, agronegócio, comércio B2B e condomínios).


▸ PERFIS QUE BUSCAMOS


- Engenheiros — Eletricistas, Automação, Produção, Mecânica, Agronomia

 ou Química, com perfil comercial ou interesse em transição para vendas

 técnicas

- Vendedores B2B com carteira PJ ativa em indústria, agronegócio,

 comércio ou construção

- Representantes Comerciais sêniores com rede em químicas, têxteis,

 plásticos, pescados, metalurgia ou alimentos

- Profissionais com 3+ anos de experiência em vendas consultivas


▸ O QUE OFERECEMOS


- Comissão escalonada de 7% a 10% sobre vendas, com bônus por meta

- Ganhos médios acima de R$ 10.000,00/mês

- Dois modelos de vínculo:

 - PJ 100% comissionado (autonomia total)

 - Híbrido: ajuda de custo de R$ 800 a R$ 1.500 + comissão

- Suporte completo de engenharia: simulações, propostas, projeto

 executivo e homologação CELESC ficam por nossa conta

- Treinamento técnico-comercial de imersão

- Materiais de apresentação corporativa e CRM estruturado

- Atuação como PJ — você administra sua agenda e território



▸ POR QUE SOLAR, POR QUE AGORA


O Brasil é o 6º maior mercado solar do mundo e cresce 30% ao ano.

Indústrias do Sul estão investindo em geração própria para proteger

margem operacional contra os reajustes da Celesc/Copel/RGE — e há mais

demanda do que capacidade comercial instalada no setor.


Para quem tem carteira B2B ativa, é o momento de transformar relacionamento

em receita recorrente.


▸ COMO SE CANDIDATAR


Preencha aqui a sua candidatura ou envie seu CV para ou Whatstapp .


Análise das candidaturas em até 48h. Entrevistas online, processo enxuto.

Vagas com início imediato.

title: Junior AI Agent Engineer (Part-Time, can transition to Full-Time) | Remote, Brazil
description:
AlphaCorp AI |


We're hiring a Junior AI Agent Engineer to join our team building production AI systems. This is a part-time role with a path to full-time for the right person. Students and early-career engineers are welcome.


What you'll work on


We work across the full AI engineering stack:

  • Software Engineering
  • AI Agent Engineering
  • RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Development
  • Prompt Engineering
  • Fine-Tuning
  • DevOps / MLOps


You'll get hands-on exposure to real systems and real problems.


What we're looking for


  • Basic spoken and written English (you'll read docs and communicate with the team)
  • Some Python experience (university coursework counts)
  • Basic understanding of AI and LLMs
  • Comfortable using an AI dev tool like Claude Code or Cursor in your daily workflow
  • Curiosity, ownership, and a willingness to learn fast


Students can apply. We care more about how you think than what's on your résumé.


How we work

  • 100% remote, anywhere in Brazil
  • Flexible working hours
  • Daily standups to stay aligned
  • Lean team, low bureaucracy, fast iteration


Compensation

  • R$ 2.000 base (gross, CLT)
  • Performance bonus of R$ 500 to R$ 2.000 per month, calculated monthly based on hours worked
  • Part-time now, with a clear transition path to full-time


Hiring process


  • A quick 30-minute intro call with the founder, in English, to get to know each other.
  • A take-home task.
  • A 1-hour follow-up call with one of our engineers, in Portuguese, to walk through how you solved the task and answer a few extra questions.


Using AI tools during the take-home is welcome and encouraged. Bad code is not.


How to apply


Send us a short message about yourself, attach your resume, anything you've built (small projects, hackathons, or coursework all count), and how you've been using AI tools in your own work. Links to GitHub, demos, or write-ups are a plus.
