title: Roteirista Redes Sociais (Finanças e Economia)
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Roteirista de Redes Sociais (Finanças/Economia) para integrar nosso time na VAROS.


A VAROS é uma das principais empresas do mercado financeiro brasileiro, com atuação nas áreas de Wealth Management, Research e Educacional. Nós valorizamos o esforço e premiamos o resultado, aplicando um modelo de partnership que permite a rápida ascensão dos colaboradores dentro da empresa.


Como Roteirista, você será responsável por pensar e criar os roteiros de vídeos curtos e longos sobre finanças, economia, investimento e geopolítica que serão usados nos vídeos divulgados nas redes sociais da VAROS e de seus sócios.


Você terá uma rotina dinâmica, criativa, com desafios diários, feedback constante e contato direto com os sócios, possibilitando uma rápida ascensão.


Responsabilidades

  • Escolha de temas e elaboração de cronograma para vídeos de finanças, economia, geopolítica e investimentos no Instagram e Youtube;
  • Realizar pesquisa técnica coletando informações e dados de diversas fontes para contribuir com a criação do roteiro;
  • Escrever roteiros de vídeos longos para o canal do YouTube da VAROS e/ou dos sócios (8 a 20 minutos), sobre temas de finanças, economia, geopolítica e mercado financeiro;
  • Escrever roteiros de Reels e TikToks (1 a 3 minutos) adaptando temas complexos para formatos curtos e de alto engajamento;
  • Manter consistência com o tom de voz da marca: conversacional, didático, com exemplos numéricos concretos em R$, sem jargão desnecessário;
  • Colaboração com o time de edição no intuito de garantir que a visão do roteiro seja traduzida fielmente para o vídeo final. Isso inclui revisar cortes preliminares, sugerir ajustes de ritmo, validar escolhas de gráficos e b-rolls e estar disponível pra tirar dúvidas do editor sobre intenção e timing.
  • Sugerir títulos e ideias de thumbs pensados em engajamento.


Requisitos


Formação e Experiência

  • Graduação em Jornalismo, Economia, Relações Internacionais ou Engenharia;
  • 3 anos ou mais de experiência como roteirista, redator, repórter ou produtor de conteúdo;
  • Portfólio com roteiros publicados;


Hard Skills

  • Domínio sólido dos fundamentos de mercado financeiro brasileiro: renda fixa, renda variável, macroeconomia, leitura de balanços e indicadores econômicos.
  • Excelente habilidade de escrita;
  • Inglês intermediário (leitura);


Soft Skills

  • Organização;
  • Criatividade


Ferramentas

  • Excel intermediário;
  • Notion;
  • IA (Claude, Perplexity);


Nós oferecemos:

  • Remuneração extremamente competitiva;

title: Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor de Busca)
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional.
  • Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual)
  • Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância.
  • Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados.
  • Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas.


Requisitos necessários

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch
  • Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância.
  • Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual).
  • Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank.
  • Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.
  • Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.


Diferenciais

  • Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes.
  • Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery.
  • Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.


Perfil esperado

  • Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário.
  • Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto.
  • Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta.
  • Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados.
  • Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares.

title: SRE - Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de uma pessoa SRE Pleno. Essa pessoa atuará no time de MLOps, responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, escalabilidade e eficiência da infraestrutura que suporta os modelos e pipelines de Machine Learning em produção. Trabalhamos em um ambiente colaborativo, com forte cultura de engenharia e incentivo ao desenvolvimento contínuo. Tudo isso em uma empresa líder no mercado brasileiro de farmácia, referência em Saúde e Bem-estar com mais 3.000 lojas em todos os estados brasileiros.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Responsabilidades:


  • Implementar e manter infraestrutura como código utilizando Terraform, seguindo padrões e boas práticas já estabelecidos pelo time.
  • Operar e dar manutenção em clusters Kubernetes, utilizando Helm e práticas de GitOps para suporte à entrega contínua de aplicações.
  • Atuar na operação do dia a dia de ambientes AWS, contribuindo para a disponibilidade e estabilidade das plataformas.
  • Apoiar o diagnóstico de problemas de rede em cloud providers, atuando em conjunto com membros mais sêniores do time em cenários mais complexos.
  • Manter pipelines de CI/CD com GitLab, colaborando com times de desenvolvimento e dados.
  • Acompanhar e utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog) para identificar anomalias e apoiar a resposta a incidentes.
  • Participar de processos de resposta a incidentes e post-mortems, contribuindo com análises e implementação de melhorias.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de FinOps, auxiliando na identificação de oportunidades de otimização de custos na nuvem.


Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos Técnicos


Obrigatórios


  • Experiência prática com Terraform para gerenciamento de infraestrutura como código.
  • Conhecimento sólido em AWS.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Kubernetes, incluindo uso de Helm e fluxos GitOps.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em GitLab (pipelines, CI/CD, repositórios).
  • Capacidade de diagnóstico em redes em ambientes cloud (VPC, security groups, DNS, load balancers, etc.).
  • Bom domínio de Linux e administração de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana e Datadog.


Diferenciais:


  • Conhecimento introdutório de práticas de FinOps em ambientes cloud.
  • Experiência ou interesse em ambientes de MLOps ou Data EngineeringPerfil comportamental
  • Boa capacidade de resolução de problemas e raciocínio analítico, com vontade de evoluir em cenários de infraestrutura e sistemas distribuídos.
  • Comunicação clara e facilidade para trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Perfil com senso de dono, proativo e aberto a aprender com o time.

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
Customer Service Representative

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Love helping people and solving problems fast? We’re looking for someone who can deliver high-quality customer experiences at scale, while keeping every interaction clear, human, and efficient. This is a hands-on role where responsiveness, empathy, and execution matter every day.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We create high-performance, eco-friendly cleaning solutions designed to make life easier without compromising sustainability.

Customer experience is at the core of our brand. Every interaction matters, and how we show up for our customers directly impacts retention, trust, and growth.


The Role

This is a high-volume, execution-focused role. You will manage day-to-day customer interactions across multiple channels, ensuring fast, accurate, and human responses.

You are not just answering tickets—you are shaping how customers experience the brand.


This Role Is For You If:

  • You communicate clearly, empathetically, and efficiently
  • You are comfortable handling high volumes of customer interactions
  • You stay calm under pressure and solve problems quickly
  • You pay attention to details and don’t let things slip
  • You take ownership of issues until they are fully resolved
  • You are comfortable working independently in a remote environment


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You avoid dealing with difficult customers
  • You prioritize speed over accuracy and quality
  • You are not comfortable multitasking across platforms


What You'll Do

Customer Support Execution

  • Manage and respond to customer inquiries via email and support platforms
  • Ensure fast, accurate, and high-quality responses at scale
  • Maintain a consistent and professional brand voice

Social Media Support

  • Respond to DMs and comments across platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok
  • Engage with the community while maintaining brand tone and consistency

Order & Refund Management

  • Process order changes, cancellations, refunds, and exchanges
  • Ensure all actions follow company policies and are accurately executed

Conflict Resolution

  • Handle complaints with empathy and clarity
  • Investigate issues thoroughly and provide complete resolutions

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Share customer feedback and recurring issues with internal teams
  • Help identify patterns that can improve product or operations


Requirements

Must have:

  • Experience in customer service (ecommerce or DTC preferred)
  • Strong written communication skills in English
  • Experience handling social media interactions is a strong plus
  • High attention to detail and ability to multitask
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)


Benefits & Compensation

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM.
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business

Ready to Apply?

If you care about delivering great customer experiences and want to be part of a fast-moving team, apply now.

description:
Quem Somos

A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a DEXIAN® atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de “staffing augmentation” dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.


O que esperar de nós

É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras; comprometimento não é só um pensamento; e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.


Key Responsibilities

  • Security: Identity and Access Management (IAM): Strong understanding of IAM roles, policies, and best practices for securing cloud resources.
  • Data Protection: Experience with encryption, key management (e.g., Cloud KMS), and data loss prevention (DLP) services.
  • Compliance: Familiarity with compliance standards and implementing security controls to meet regulatory requirements.
  • HashiCorp Vault: Proficiency in using HashiCorp Vault for secrets management, encryption, and access control.
  • Automation and Scripting:
  • Scripting Languages: Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, and PowerShell for automating tasks and managing cloud resources.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Experience with IaC tools like Terraform, Cloud Deployment Manager, and Ansible for provisioning and managing infrastructure.
  • HashiCorp Terraform Enterprise: Expertise in using Terraform Enterprise for infrastructure automation, collaboration, and governance.
  • CI/CD Pipelines: Knowledge of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) tools and practices (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Cloud Build).
  • DevOps and Monitoring:
  • Containerization: Expertise in containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes).
  • Monitoring and Logging: Proficiency in monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Stackdriver, Prometheus, Grafana) to ensure the health and performance of cloud environments.
  • Incident Management: Experience with incident response and management tools (e.g., PagerDuty, Opsgenie) to handle and resolve issues promptly.
  • Data and Analytics:
  • Big Data: Knowledge of big data processing and analytics services (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc) for handling large-scale data workloads.
  • Machine Learning: Familiarity with machine learning services (e.g., AI Platform, AutoML) and integrating ML models into cloud applications.
  • Data Integration: Experience with data integration and ETL tools (e.g., Cloud Data Fusion, Apache Airflow) for building data pipelines.
  • Cloud Architecture:
  • Design Patterns: Understanding of cloud-native design patterns and best practices for building scalable, resilient, and cost-effective solutions.
  • Microservices: Experience with microservices architecture and related technologies (e.g., Istio, Envoy) for building and managing distributed applications.
  • API Management: Proficiency in API management tools (e.g., Apigee) for designing, securing, and monitoring APIs.


Required Qualifications

Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.

Cloud Infrastructure:

Compute: Proficiency in managing and optimizing virtual machines, containers, and serverless computing on GCP (e.g., Compute Engine, Kubernetes Engine, Cloud Functions).

Networking: In-depth knowledge of VPCs, subnets, firewalls, VPNs, and hybrid connectivity solutions (e.g., Cloud Interconnect, Cloud VPN).

Storage: Expertise in various storage solutions, including Cloud Storage, Persistent Disks, Filestore, and database services like Cloud SQL, Bigtable, and Firestore.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Regime 100% Home Office.

Tempo indeterminado.

Equipe internacional.

At Bluedot BPO Solutions, we connect top LATAM talent with high-performing U.S. teams. We are looking for a highly organized and execution-driven Marketing Assistant to support digital marketing operations for international clients.


This fully remote role offers daily exposure to the U.S. market and a clear growth path for professionals who want to build a long-term career in Digital Marketing and Marketing Operations.


What We Offer

  • Compensation of R$5,000
  • 100% remote, aligned with PST working hours
  • Direct exposure to international clients and global teams
  • Long-term position
  • Participation in strategic digital marketing projects
  • Structured, dynamic, and performance-driven environment
  • Real growth opportunities into higher-responsibility roles


Your Responsibilities

  • Support end-to-end execution of digital marketing campaigns
  • Assist in organizing scopes, timelines, and KPIs
  • Update and manage project management tools (Asana, ClickUp, Jira, Trello)
  • Coordinate communication between designers, copywriters, media buyers, and developers
  • Ensure organization of briefings, assets, and documentation
  • Track creative deliverables and deadlines
  • Collect and organize campaign performance metrics (paid media, social, email, SEO)
  • Support KPI analysis and performance reporting
  • Identify potential operational risks and escalate when necessary
  • Participate in internal meetings and, when needed, client calls
  • Prepare summaries and follow-ups to ensure team alignment


What We’re Looking For

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in digital marketing or agency environment
  • Experience managing multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Familiarity with project management tools
  • Functional knowledge of digital channels (social, paid media, email, SEO, landing pages)
  • Advanced or fluent English (written and spoken)
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, remote environments


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in agencies or startups
  • Experience working with international clients
  • Knowledge of dashboards and performance reporting
  • Certifications in digital marketing or project management


Technical Requirements

  • Two monitors
  • Laptop with good performance
  • High-speed internet
  • Professional headset
  • Quiet and structured home office


Build your international career in Marketing.

Work directly with U.S. teams and grow in a structured, high-performance environment.

title: Gerente de Technical Advisor (ArcGIS / GIS)
description:
Gerente de Technical Advisor (GIS / ArcGIS)


Descrição da vaga


  • Gerenciar e responder pela gestão do atendimento, fortalecendo o engajamento com o negócio das indústrias foco, em sinergia com Soluções, Marketing e Comercial, através da utilização de melhores práticas de ferramentas, processos e gestão de pessoas visando o aumento da qualidade percebida pelo cliente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Elaborar, implantar e acompanhar a estratégia da área (planejamento, orçamento, cronograma e indicadores);
  • Participar da construção da estratégia de negócios dos clientes e da Diretoria;
  • Garantir o engajamento com a estratégia da Diretoria/Empresa, desdobrando todas as iniciativas com o time;
  • Acompanhar e oferecer visibilidade do andamento das entregas sob sua gestão;
  • Promover sinergia entre as áreas de Soluções e demais Diretorias/Áreas de empresa;
  • Orientar as áreas de negócios em relação as melhores práticas;
  • Identificar pontos de melhoria nos processos de vendas, desenvolvendo ações alinhadas com as necessidades dos processos das áreas de negócio;
  • Gestão do atendimento dos clientes garantindo o sucesso nos negócios utilizando nossos produtos e serviços
  • Atuar na elaboração e execução de um plano para a intensificação do uso das tecnologias adquiridas para alavancar seus processos de negócio;
  • Garantir que as demandas necessárias a estratégia de negócio do cliente, tenham os recursos e ações direcionadas conforme sua expectativa;
  • Garantir o atendimento especializado para contratos EA/EAP;
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com os Canais de Venda no desenvolvimento das contas e com a área de Suporte e Customer Success garantindo a satisfação dos clientes;
  • Acompanhar e oferecer visibilidade do andamento das entregas sob sua gestão;
  • Gestão de faturamento e custos;
  • Gestão da alocação dos profissionais conforme meta e políticas estabelecidas.
  • Elaborar, conferir e validar Relatórios Gerenciais para apoiar na tomada de decisões da empresa;
  • Promover o desenvolvimento de novos projetos, melhoria dos processos e das atividades compartilhadas ou interdependentes, identificando e aplicando boas práticas de mercado e realizando reuniões interdepartamentais;
  • Gerenciar atividades da área, estabelecendo cronogramas, indicadores de desempenho e orientando sobre a forma a se fazer cumprir as metas de produtividade dentro dos prazos estabelecidos e negociados, visando assegurar o cumprimento de todas as obrigações da empresa;
  • Negociar prazos para o fornecimento de informações pelas gerências, avaliar a qualidade destas e acompanhar o lançamento destes dados, visando assegurar a qualidade do relatório e sua entrega nos prazos estabelecidos;
  • Realizar a Gestão de Pessoas, acompanhar, avaliar e desenvolver o time;
  • Ser referência no exercício da nossa cultura, estar envolvido com nosso negócio, se interessar pelo desenvolvimento da sua área e da empresa como um todo
  • Realizar a gestão e controle orçamentário da área;
  • Realizar a gestão de Processos, adesão as Políticas de Qualidade e gestão de riscos e mudanças.


Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:

  • Graduado/Especializações.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento em GIS (Geographic Information System), IT (Technology Information) em Estratégia de Empresas;
  • Conhecimentos em Planejamento Estratégico;
  • Conhecimento em análise de custos e orçamentos;
  • Gestão de Pessoas e Performance de Times;
  • Experiência com o ArcGIS;
  • Inglês Fluente/Avançado;
  • Análise e interpretação de dados.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Mestrado;
  • Certificações Doutorado/Pós-Doutorado;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão em profundidade os produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem.

title: Gerente de projetos/Atendimento - [Marketing]
description:
Pessoa Gestora de Projetos e Atendimento - Marketing


Sobre a Frame Business

Na Frame Business, não entregamos apenas \"conteúdo\" ou \"posts\". Somos o motor de intenção qualificada para ecossistemas de negócios. Atuamos na intersecção entre estratégia de mídia, automação e branding para transformar complexidade em faturamento real.

O que você fará (Seu papel no nosso Sistema Integrado)

  • Interface Estratégica: Você não será apenas um \"contato\", mas o elo que traduz as dores de clientes e lideranças em crescimento em briefings de alta conversão.
  • Gestão do Cronograma: Gerenciar a Camada Operacional, garantindo que o fluxo entre estratégia, criação e mídia performance (Meta Ads/Google Ads) seja impecável e dentro dos prazos.
  • Qualidade e Entrega de Valor: Revisar cada entrega sob a ótica de quem contrata, garantindo que o \"constrangimento\" de uma proposta de alto valor nunca aconteça, pois a entrega sustenta o preço.
  • Gestão de Pauta e Recursos: Otimizar a operação interna para evitar gargalos, garantindo que o time foque no que realmente move o ponteiro do negócio.

O que buscamos (DNA Frame)

  • Experiência em Agência (mandatário): Vivência real com atendimento ou gestão de projetos em ambientes de performance.
  • Mestria em Ferramentas: Domínio de sistemas de gestão (Asana, Monday ou Notion ) e familiaridade com estruturas de mídia (nomenclaturas de campanhas, UTMs e testes A/B).
  • Comunicação de Impacto: Capacidade de conduzir reuniões com executivos(as), focando em clareza, dados e resolução de problemas.
  • Mentalidade Pró-Solução: Perfil que entende que o lead \"esfria\" em minutos e que a agilidade é nossa maior aliada.
  • Nível Pleno+

Diferenciais que valorizamos

  • Experiência com projetos de expansão internacional ou automação de marketing.
  • Conhecimento técnico em funis de vendas e estratégias de remarketing focado em \"quebra de objeções\".


Instrução para Candidatura:

Mostre-nos seu diferencial. Candidate-se via LinkedIn ou envie seu portfólio focado em cases de gestão para .

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
Customer Service Representative

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Love helping people and solving problems fast? We’re looking for someone who can deliver high-quality customer experiences at scale, while keeping every interaction clear, human, and efficient. This is a hands-on role where responsiveness, empathy, and execution matter every day.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We create high-performance, eco-friendly cleaning solutions designed to make life easier without compromising sustainability.

Customer experience is at the core of our brand. Every interaction matters, and how we show up for our customers directly impacts retention, trust, and growth.


The Role

This is a high-volume, execution-focused role. You will manage day-to-day customer interactions across multiple channels, ensuring fast, accurate, and human responses.

You are not just answering tickets—you are shaping how customers experience the brand.


This Role Is For You If:

  • You communicate clearly, empathetically, and efficiently
  • You are comfortable handling high volumes of customer interactions
  • You stay calm under pressure and solve problems quickly
  • You pay attention to details and don’t let things slip
  • You take ownership of issues until they are fully resolved
  • You are comfortable working independently in a remote environment


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You avoid dealing with difficult customers
  • You prioritize speed over accuracy and quality
  • You are not comfortable multitasking across platforms


What You'll Do

Customer Support Execution

  • Manage and respond to customer inquiries via email and support platforms
  • Ensure fast, accurate, and high-quality responses at scale
  • Maintain a consistent and professional brand voice

Social Media Support

  • Respond to DMs and comments across platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok
  • Engage with the community while maintaining brand tone and consistency

Order & Refund Management

  • Process order changes, cancellations, refunds, and exchanges
  • Ensure all actions follow company policies and are accurately executed

Conflict Resolution

  • Handle complaints with empathy and clarity
  • Investigate issues thoroughly and provide complete resolutions

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Share customer feedback and recurring issues with internal teams
  • Help identify patterns that can improve product or operations


Requirements

Must have:

  • Experience in customer service (ecommerce or DTC preferred)
  • Strong written communication skills in English
  • Experience handling social media interactions is a strong plus
  • High attention to detail and ability to multitask
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)


Benefits & Compensation

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM.
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business

Ready to Apply?

If you care about delivering great customer experiences and want to be part of a fast-moving team, apply now.

title: \"SAP BTP IS Cloud Integration Developer #1002182\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição:

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional altamente qualificado(a) em SAP Cloud Integration (CPI) para atuar no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de integrações em ambiente SAP Cloud. Essa pessoa será responsável por construir soluções robustas, apoiar times globais e garantir a estabilidade e eficiência dos fluxos de integração.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e aprimorar integration flows (iFlows) no SAP Cloud Integration, seguindo boas práticas estabelecidas.
  • Projetar e implementar cenários de integração entre sistemas SAP e não-SAP.
  • Atuar na manutenção e melhoria contínua de interfaces existentes.
  • Realizar análise de incidentes, troubleshooting e root cause analysis.
  • Apoiar equipes internas com consultoria técnica e resolução de problemas.
  • Participar de projetos de migração (ex: SAP Process Orchestration → SAP Cloud Integration)
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de infraestrutura, segurança, rede e change management.
  • Garantir governança dos artefatos, incluindo transporte, versionamento e gerenciamento de pacotes.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida com SAP Cloud Integration (CPI)
  • Domínio de Graphical Mapping e uso de funções padrão.
  • Experiência com configuração e uso de adapters SAP (HTTP, OData, SFTP, IDoc, etc.)
  • Conhecimento em SAP BTP Integration Suite, incluindo:
  • Cloud Connector
  • Open Connectors
  • Forte entendimento de:
  • Protocolos de comunicação (HTTP, SOAP, etc.)
  • Métodos de autenticação
  • Gerenciamento de certificados (Keystore)
  • Experiência com governança de integração, incluindo:
  • Transport Management
  • Package Management
  • Externalização de parâmetros
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban ou similares)
  • Inglês avançado/fluente (obrigatório)


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em Groovy Script e/ou Java EE
  • Experiência com XSLT Mapping
  • Familiaridade com OAuth, SAML e autenticação moderna
  • Experiência com SAP S/4HANA
  • Conhecimento básico em SQL Server e linguagem SQL
  • Experiência com SAP SuccessFactors
  • Conhecimentos em Cloud Computing


Competências comportamentais:

  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de interação com diferentes stakeholders
  • Perfil colaborativo para atuação em times ágeis
  • Proatividade e autonomia
  • Facilidade para aprendizado de novas tecnologias


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

Love helping people and solving problems fast? We’re looking for someone who can deliver high-quality customer experiences at scale, while keeping every interaction clear, human, and efficient. This is a hands-on role where responsiveness, empathy, and execution matter every day.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We create high-performance, eco-friendly cleaning solutions designed to make life easier without compromising sustainability.

Customer experience is at the core of our brand. Every interaction matters, and how we show up for our customers directly impacts retention, trust, and growth.

You are not just answering tickets—you are shaping how customers experience the brand.

  • You stay calm under pressure and solve problems quickly
  • You pay attention to details and don’t let things slip
  • You take ownership of issues until they are fully resolved

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • High attention to detail and ability to multitask

If you care about delivering great customer experiences and want to be part of a fast-moving team, apply now.

Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.


Key Responsibilities

  • Security: Identity and Access Management (IAM): Strong understanding of IAM roles, policies, and best practices for securing cloud resources.
  • Data Protection: Experience with encryption, key management (e.g., Cloud KMS), and data loss prevention (DLP) services.
  • Compliance: Familiarity with compliance standards and implementing security controls to meet regulatory requirements.
  • HashiCorp Vault: Proficiency in using HashiCorp Vault for secrets management, encryption, and access control.
  • Automation and Scripting:
  • Scripting Languages: Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, and PowerShell for automating tasks and managing cloud resources.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Experience with IaC tools like Terraform, Cloud Deployment Manager, and Ansible for provisioning and managing infrastructure.
  • HashiCorp Terraform Enterprise: Expertise in using Terraform Enterprise for infrastructure automation, collaboration, and governance.
  • CI/CD Pipelines: Knowledge of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) tools and practices (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Cloud Build).
  • DevOps and Monitoring:
  • Containerization: Expertise in containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes).
  • Monitoring and Logging: Proficiency in monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Stackdriver, Prometheus, Grafana) to ensure the health and performance of cloud environments.
  • Incident Management: Experience with incident response and management tools (e.g., PagerDuty, Opsgenie) to handle and resolve issues promptly.
  • Data and Analytics:
  • Big Data: Knowledge of big data processing and analytics services (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc) for handling large-scale data workloads.
  • Machine Learning: Familiarity with machine learning services (e.g., AI Platform, AutoML) and integrating ML models into cloud applications.
  • Data Integration: Experience with data integration and ETL tools (e.g., Cloud Data Fusion, Apache Airflow) for building data pipelines.
  • Cloud Architecture:
  • Design Patterns: Understanding of cloud-native design patterns and best practices for building scalable, resilient, and cost-effective solutions.
  • Microservices: Experience with microservices architecture and related technologies (e.g., Istio, Envoy) for building and managing distributed applications.
  • API Management: Proficiency in API management tools (e.g., Apigee) for designing, securing, and monitoring APIs.


Required Qualifications

Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.

Cloud Infrastructure:

Compute: Proficiency in managing and optimizing virtual machines, containers, and serverless computing on GCP (e.g., Compute Engine, Kubernetes Engine, Cloud Functions).

Networking: In-depth knowledge of VPCs, subnets, firewalls, VPNs, and hybrid connectivity solutions (e.g., Cloud Interconnect, Cloud VPN).

Storage: Expertise in various storage solutions, including Cloud Storage, Persistent Disks, Filestore, and database services like Cloud SQL, Bigtable, and Firestore.

Regime 100% Home Office.

Tempo indeterminado.

Equipe internacional.

title: Especialista em infraestrutura de TI - Temporário
description:
Objetivo do papel no projeto

Estamos em busca de um especialista em Infraestrutura / Data Center com sólida experiência em ambientes corporativos ou bancários, atuando em capacity planning, alta disponibilidade, arquitetura de data centers e continuidade de serviços de TI.

Vivência em ambientes ativo‑ativo, análise de carregamento, storage, virtualização e suporte a testes de contingência.

Atribuições

  • Análise de capacidade atual e futura de:
  • compute (clusters, virtualização, CPU, memória);
  • storage (capacidade, IOPS, latência, replicação);
  • network (largura de banda, latência inter‑DC).
  • Interpretação de métricas históricas e tendências.
  • Elaboração de cenários prospectivos :
  • crescimento orgânico;
  • contingência (DC único absorvendo 100% da carga);
  • iniciativas estratégicas (ex.: IA, aumento de criticidade).
  • Avaliação técnica de: arquitetura físico‑lógica dos Data Center (DCs), modelo ativo‑ativo real , incluindo exceções técnicas e dependências entre sistemas e infraestrutura.
  • Análise comparativa de alternativas (enterprise e colocation);
  • Suporte a entregáveis e transferência de conhecimento
  • Contribuição técnica para elaboração de relatórios e parecer técnico.


  • Experiência necessária
  • 5 anos em infraestrutura de TI corporativa ou bancária;
  • Vivência comprovada em Data Centers de médio/grande porte ;
  • Experiência prévia com ambientes ativo‑ativo ou alta disponibilidade e projetos de continuidade ou contingência.


  • Conhecimentos técnicos
  • Virtualização (VMware / Hyper‑V / equivalentes);
  • Storage enterprise (SAN, replicação síncrona/quase síncrona);
  • Networks de alta disponibilidade (LAN/WAN, inter‑DC);
  • Capacidade, performance, latência e gargalos.

Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to support reporting, billing processes, and revenue operations. Position Overview


We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Financial Analyst to support financial operations, reporting, and billing processes. This role will act as a key partner across Finance, Sales, and Customer Success teams, ensuring alignment between contracts, invoicing, and revenue recognition. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with hands-on experience in billing, revenue operations, and financial reporting. This role requires both strategic insight and operational execution, contributing to process improvements and supporting the company’s financial health and scalability.



What You'll Do:


  • Analyze financial performance, identify trends, and deliver actionable insights to support strategic decision-making
  • Enhance financial reporting, tools, and processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability
  • Ensure customer contracts are aligned with invoicing terms and revenue recognition policies
  • Prepare and process invoices accurately and in a timely manner, resolving discrepancies when needed
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to ensure billing accuracy and proper contract implementation
  • Monitor accounts receivable, track outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments
  • Maintain accurate billing records and supporting documentation for audits and reporting
  • Contribute to optimizing and streamlining the quote-to-cash process
  • Support financial reporting cycles and assist with audits related to billing and revenue operations
  • Perform ad-hoc financial analysis and support additional finance-related initiatives.



What You Bring:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • 4–7+ years of experience in financial analysis, billing, accounting, or revenue operations
  • Strong understanding of invoicing processes, revenue recognition principles, and financial reporting
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience with ERP or financial systems is a plus
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills
  • High attention to detail with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to translate financial data into clear, actionable insights.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with billing or subscription-based business models
  • Familiarity with quote-to-cash processes
  • Experience supporting audits and compliance processes
  • Background in process optimization and financial systems improvements
  • Experience working in high-growth or scaling organizations.


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern financial systems and tools
  • High-impact role supporting financial strategy and operations
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

title: Business Strategy Consultant
description:
Organizations collect mountains of data about their customers — and still struggle to act on it. They run surveys, build dashboards, and generate reports, but often lack the structured thinking to turn those outputs into decisions that actually change the business. This role exists to close that gap.


Responsibilities:

  • Diagnosing drivers of customer satisfaction, loyalty, and operational performance across enterprise clients.
  • Structuring insights from large datasets and Voice of Customer programs into strategic recommendations.
  • Developing analytical frameworks that connect behavioral and operational data to business outcomes.
  • Building executive presentations and data-driven narratives for C-level and senior stakeholders.
  • Contributing to consulting proposals and new service offerings — translating insights into commercial value propositions.
  • Supporting the development of consulting methodologies, tools, and analytical approaches.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, Data Science, or Marketing.
  • 3–6 years of experience in roles such as Strategy consulting; Business analytics or insights; Strategic planning; Business intelligence or data-driven product roles.
  • Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.
  • Structured problem-solving and analytical framework development.
  • Ability to synthesize qualitative and quantitative inputs into strategic recommendations
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.


Desired Skills:

  • Fluency in Spanish.
  • SQL, Python, or R.
  • Power BI, Tableau, or other BI tools.
  • Experience with customer analytics, Voice of Customer programs, or customer journey analysis.

title: Oracle Cloud Finance Functional Consultant

title: Médico do Trabalho - vaga exclusiva para PcD - Presencial

Demonstramos isso oferecendo uma cultura de pertencimento, caminhos claros para desenvolvimento de carreira, programas de apoio profissional, coaching e mentoria, além de uma rede global de amigos e colegas que estarão ao seu lado. (E tem muito mais!).

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Associate Account Executive - Biopharma
description:

Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as AbbVie, Astrazeneca, Pfizer, Merck. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


Our Biopharma team is growing, and we are looking for an experienced Associate Account Executive to expand institutional sales of our scientific video journal and databases to biopharma companies in North America. If you are ambitious, results-driven, and can develop relationships with scientists and progress opportunities, this position could be an excellent opportunity for you.


Responsibilities:


  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing business for assigned biopharma accounts.
  • Conduct active outreach to build and progress opportunities in the pipeline to meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Build and execute a persistent outbound sales strategy, including cold calls and emails, to generate interest and accelerate new business generation.
  • Establish and maintain strong and professional relationships with biopharma librarians, R&D leadership and stakeholders.
  • Work with the marketing and customer success teams to customize marketing activities & provide support for each account.

title: LIFECYCLE & RETENTION STRATEGIST (Klaviyo)
description:
ABOUT ATTN AGENCY

ATTN Agency (pronounced Attention Agency) is a boutique, performance-driven digital marketing agency trusted by e-commerce and DTC brands looking to scale profitably. We specialize in full-funnel growth across Google, Meta, TikTok, Klaviyo, Postscript, and emerging platforms — with a laser focus on ROAS, new customer acquisition, and incremental revenue.

We don't just manage emails. We build scalable systems for sustainable growth and we're selective about who we work with and who we hire. If you're obsessed with performance, welcome home.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Lifecycle and Retention Strategist to own and drive retention strategy across a portfolio of high-growth eCommerce and DTC brands. This is a senior, client-facing role that sits at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution oversight.

You will be responsible for building and managing full lifecycle programs spanning email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty, while leading the strategic direction for each brand on your portfolio. You think in customer journeys, speak fluently in data, and know how to translate insights into programs that move revenue.

You will also play a key role in evaluating and recommending the right tech stack for each client, including loyalty platforms, subscription tools, review integrations, and emerging retention channels, ensuring every brand is set up with the right infrastructure to scale.

This is not a coordinator role. We need someone who has been here before, can lead without being managed, and is ready to take ownership of outcomes.


SCOPE OF WORK

Strategy and Campaign Planning

  • Own the lifecycle roadmap across email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty for a portfolio of 5 to 7 high-growth eCommerce brands
  • Develop rolling 30-day campaign calendars aligned with product launches, promotions, and paid media activity
  • Write clear, detailed copy briefs and flow outlines tailored to each brand's voice, tone, and audience
  • Build segmentation frameworks and customer journey maps designed to maximize engagement and lifetime value
  • Leverage AI tools and advanced analytics to uncover opportunities and improve workflow efficiency
  • Delegate campaign and flow builds to Retention Coordinators, then review, QA, and deliver actionable feedback
  • Coordinate with design and copy teams to keep assets and ClickUp timelines on track
  • Mentor junior team members and actively contribute to growing their strategic and technical capabilities

Optimization and Performance

  • Analyze performance across deliverability, engagement, conversion rate, revenue per recipient, and cohort LTV
  • Design and execute A/B and multivariate tests across creative, cadence, offers, and segments and translate results into clear next steps
  • Refine benchmarks, identify trends, and get ahead of problems before they affect performance
  • Evaluate and pilot emerging retention channels including loyalty tiers, push notifications, and in-app messaging
  • Document learnings and contribute to internal best practice development and team training

Tech Stack Management and Recommendations

  • Audit existing client tech stacks, identify gaps, and recommend the right tools for each brand's stage of growth
  • Advise on and help implement solutions across loyalty and rewards (Yotpo, Smile.io, LoyaltyLion), subscription management (Recharge, Skio, Stay), review and UGC platforms (Okendo, Stamped, Junip), SMS (Postscript, Attentive, Klaviyo SMS), post-purchase tools (Wonderment, Malomo, AfterShip), push notifications, and direct mail (PostPilot, PaperRun, etc.)
  • Stay current on the retention technology landscape and bring proactive recommendations to clients and the internal team

Client Collaboration

  • Join monthly or bi-weekly client calls led by Account Managers to present strategy, performance insights, and testing roadmaps
  • Deliver concise, data-driven performance summaries that clearly communicate wins, gaps, and next steps
  • Partner with Account Managers to ensure retention strategy integrates seamlessly with each client's broader growth initiatives


REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 4+ years of lifecycle and retention marketing experience, the majority within eCommerce or DTC
  • Proven track record managing email and SMS programs that have directly contributed to measurable revenue growth
  • Deep knowledge of Klaviyo including flows, segmentation, deliverability, and performance analysis
  • Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously, preferably in an agency environment
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, spot trends, and build a clear strategic response
  • Solid understanding of the eCommerce retention tech ecosystem with the ability to make confident platform recommendations
  • Experience briefing and managing creative and copy teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills including the ability to present strategy clearly to clients
  • Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment
  • Proficiency with ClickUp (Or similar project management platform), Slack, and GSuite


NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with SMS platforms such as Postscript or Attentive
  • Hands-on experience implementing or managing loyalty and subscription tools
  • Familiarity with direct mail as a retention channel
  • Experience mentoring or managing junior team members
  • Experience with other ESPs like Braze, Iterable, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud


HOW WE WORK

You will work directly with our Director of Lifecycle and Retention Marketing and collaborate closely with Account Managers, additional Retention Strategists, designers, and copywriters. We operate through ClickUp for project management and Slack for day-to-day communication. Availability and responsiveness between 9am and 5pm US hours on business days is required.

What We Offer:

  • An innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and growth.

Join iMerit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of

Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage

you to apply!

title: Subject Matter Expert – Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.


We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.


We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.


Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again; simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.


Links to more information on Prolific

Website

Youtube


Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Sales AI Agent Builder
description:
Sales AI Agent Builder

Role Overview:

You will architect and manage a fleet of autonomous Sales Agents that perform end-to-end prospecting, qualification, and meeting scheduling. Unlike traditional Sales Ops, you won't just build workflows; you will build reasoning systems that research prospects, handle objections, and manage their own \"inboxes\" to deliver qualified meetings to our SEs. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.

Key Responsibilities:

• Autonomous Lead Qualification: Design agents to \"vet\" inbound leads by querying external data sources and internal CRM history to determine if they meet our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP).

• Inbox Management & Objection Handling: Deploy agents (using LLMs like GPT-4o or Claude) that can read incoming emails, categorize intent, and draft/send context-aware replies to handle common objections.

• Live Sales Assistant (RAG): Build a \"Sales Knowledge Base\" using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) so agents can instantly reference case studies, pricing, and competitor battlecards during autonomous chats.

• CRM Data Integrity: Ensure agents \"write back\" all interactions to Salesforce/HubSpot, keeping data clean and attribution accurate without rep intervention.

Qualifications:

• Experience: 4+ years in Growth or Solutions Engineering in a B2B SaaS environment.

• AI Tooling: Experience with \"Agent-as-a-Service\" platforms (e.g., 11x, Regie.ai, Lyzr) or building custom agents via LangChain / LangGraph.

• Sales Stack Mastery: Deep expertise in Salesforce/HubSpot, Salesloft/Outreach, and data providers like ZoomInfo or 6sense.

• Analytical Rigor: Ability to A/B test agent prompts and \"reasoning loops\" to improve meeting-set rates.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite:

FirstIgnite builds best-in-class software that accelerates commercialization and innovation by connecting scientific research with industry partners. We support universities, national labs, and research hospitals worldwide with tools that simplify complex science and identify real partnership opportunities.


Role Overview:

The Data Engineer will lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data systems that integrate diverse datasets. This role includes deploying AI and machine learning solutions to enhance insights, manage complex data relationships, and drive actionable intelligence for FirstIgnite’s platform. You will mentor and manage a team of data engineers while working cross-functionally to innovate and deliver impactful AI-driven solutions.


Responsibilities :

  • Lead the architecture, development, and optimization of scalable data pipelines for patents, grants, clinical trials, publications, labs, and firmographic sources.
  • Build and maintain ETL workflows on AWS using Glue (PySpark), Lambda, S3, and RDS PostgreSQL.
  • Explore and implement complementary data storage solutions as needed.
  • Apply machine learning and LLM-based techniques to extract, structure, and enrich data at scale.
  • Ensure data integrity, security, accuracy, and governance across all systems.
  • Implement tools for data exploration, visualization, and actionable insights.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to drive AI-driven innovation.
  • Evaluate emerging AI/ML techniques and tools to enhance platform capabilities.
  • Maintain version control, CI/CD pipelines, and reproducible workflows for the data engineering team.


Requirements :

  • Strong programming expertise in Python, with experience building production data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS data services (Glue/PySpark, Lambda, S3, RDS PostgreSQL, SSM) or equivalent cloud data stacks.
  • Familiarity with RESTful and GraphQL APIs, ETL processes, and data integration strategies.
  • Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI-enhanced data applications.
  • Strong analytical skills, including evaluating trade-offs of data ingestion and storage methods.
  • Leadership experience managing data engineering or AI teams in SaaS or tech environments.
  • Solid knowledge of version control (Git) and CI/CD practices.
  • Exposure to data science / ML libraries (Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch) and managed ML platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI) is a plus.
  • Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills in cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and drive projects from conception to deployment.


Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience with web scraping at scale (Firecrawl or similar).
  • LLM-based data extraction and prompt engineering for structured output.
  • Data quality instrumentation and observability for pipelines.

  • Manage and maintain artifacts using JIRA (backlog, stories, tasks, progress tracking) and Confluence (documentation, specifications, and decisions).

  • Lead Agile ceremonies when necessary, especially in the PO’s absence or when additional facilitation is required.

Oracle Database

Comunicação e Consultoria

  • Experiência em consultoria ou atendimento a múltiplos clientes simultaneamente


Formação

  • Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia, Estatística ou áreas correlatas


Diferenciais

  • Certificações Oracle (OCA, OCP e OCI)
  • Experiência com outros bancos de dados: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB


Perfil Comportamental

  • Forte capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas complexos
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva (técnica e com negócio)
  • Organização para atuar com múltiplos clientes e demandas simultâneas
  • Postura consultiva, com foco em melhoria contínua e geração de valor


O que oferecemos

Required Skills:

  • TypeScript / Node.js primary language

  • PostgreSQL complex queries, migrations, enum types, indexing

Preferred Experience:

  • E-sign / digital agreement flows
  • Multi-channel communications (SMS via Twilio, email via Resend)


Scope of Work:

  • Along with our partner, we are seeking someone to quickly modify and rewrite the onboarding process to reduce friction and delays. You will implement new features through the Plaid API and other onboarding processes to eliminate drop-off and improve customer experience.


Benefits:

If you’re someone who can look at a messy manual process, see the system hiding inside it, and build something that runs without you, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

  • Promote and apply specification-driven development practices, including clear technical design documents and formalized functional requirements

  • Optimize data processing pipelines and database interactions
  • Design and maintain robust APIs for internal consumers
  • Support both real-time and batch processing requirements

  • Promote best practices in testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and observability

title: Senior Data Scientist/AI Engineer
description:
Role Overview

KPIT is seeking a highly skilled, hands-on Senior Data Scientist / AI Engineer (Remote) to architect, develop, and deliver end-to-end Machine Learning and AI solutions within the Azure ecosystem.


The successful candidate will be responsible for the entire AI lifecycle—from designing scalable data pipelines to deploying production-grade AI agents capable of complex, multi-step reasoning. This role is ideal for an engineer who excels at bridging the gap between experimental data science and robust, scalable MLOps.


Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Solution Delivery: Own the full lifecycle of AI/ML solutions, from initial problem definition and data acquisition to production deployment and monitoring.
  • Data Engineering & Pipeline Development: Build and maintain high-performance, scalable data pipelines using PySpark and Spark on Azure Databricks.
  • Model Development & Feature Engineering: Perform advanced feature engineering, data preparation, and sophisticated model development for diverse business use cases.
  • Agentic AI & GenAI: Develop and deploy AI agents and workflows utilizing multi-step reasoning, tool usage, and Generative AI frameworks.
  • MLOps & Lifecycle Management: Implement and manage MLflow for experiment tracking; monitor model performance, data drift, and system reliability in production environments.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Business, Data Engineering, and Analytics teams to translate business requirements into technical AI solutions.
  • Technical Leadership: Act as a subject matter expert, mentoring junior team members and driving engineering best practices.


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Programming & Data: Expert-level proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • Big Data & Cloud: Strong hands-on experience with PySpark, Apache Spark, and Azure Databricks.
  • Machine Learning: Deep understanding of ML workflows, model evaluation techniques, and statistical modeling.
  • MLOps: Practical experience with MLflow and fundamental MLOps principles (CI/CD for ML, model versioning, and monitoring).
  • Generative AI: Proven exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen).
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.


Experience Requirements

  • Professional Experience: 5–6 years of hands-on experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI Engineering.
  • Production Experience: A proven track record of deploying and maintaining ML/AI models in a production environment.
  • Cloud Expertise: Extensive experience working within cloud environments, specifically Microsoft Azure.


About KPIT

KPIT is a global partner to the automotive and mobility ecosystem. We deliver end-to-end engineering, data, and AI-led digital transformation solutions to leading Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and Tier-1 suppliers worldwide, shaping the future of mobility.

title: Solution Consultant
description:
Employment Type: Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2B)


About Sisense

Sisense is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for over 2,000 global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

With the recent launch of Sisense Intelligence, including the Intelligence Assistant (natural-language analytics creation), Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (secure external LLM integration), and Managed LLM capabilities, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences at enterprise scale.


The Role

As a Solution Consultant on our Field Engineering team, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to strategic customers, guiding them through complex analytics and data initiatives to achieve measurable business outcomes. You will lead technical discovery, design best-practice solution architectures, and partner closely with customers and internal teams to ensure successful, scalable deployments across cloud-native and embedded environments.


Why Join Our Field Engineering Services Team

You’ll operate at the intersection of customer success, product innovation, and business impact. This role gives you direct influence over high-value implementations, the opportunity to shape product direction through customer insights, and the chance to work on cutting-edge AI-embedded analytics projects with global enterprises. You’ll collaborate with diverse teams while driving real value for customers and contributing to Sisense’s growth.


Responsibilities

  • Partner directly with customers to accelerate analytics initiatives, recommend scalable architectures, and align technical solutions with long-term business goals.
  • Lead deep technical discovery sessions to understand customer data maturity, use cases, and operational constraints.
  • Own the technical customer relationship as a trusted advisor, guiding solution design across cloud-native, embedded, and secure analytics environments.
  • Design, review, and optimize data models, queries, and analytical workflows to support performant, scalable solutions.
  • Deliver onboarding sessions, solution walkthroughs, and enablement workshops tailored to customers with intermediate to advanced data and analytics maturity.
  • Create and deliver customized technical presentations and demonstrations for audiences ranging from hands-on practitioners to executive stakeholders.
  • Provide guidance on authentication, security, and access control concepts, including SSO patterns and user-level data access strategies.
  • Consult on embedding analytics into applications, including session handling and integration best practices.
  • Support solution reviews, migrations, upgrades, and architectural optimizations across customer environments.
  • Assist customers with platform administration and configuration tasks, including API automation and environment setup.
  • Collaborate closely with internal engineering, product, and support teams to surface customer feedback, identify issues, and influence future enhancements.
  • Capture and share best practices, reference architectures, and technical assets to scale knowledge across customers and internal teams.
  • Evangelize Sisense best practices through workshops, community engagement, and technical thought leadership.


About You

  • 3-5+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role (e.g., Solution Consultant, Pre-Sales Engineer, Technical Consultant, Implementation Specialist, or similar).
  • Hands-on experience with modern BI and analytics platforms (Sisense preferred; Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar acceptable).
  • Proven success leading or contributing to complex BI, cloud, or data platform implementations, from discovery through delivery.
  • Strong data modeling expertise within a BI context, including dimensional modeling and working with large, complex datasets.
  • SQL proficiency: understands join types, normalization - has the ability to join data across disparate sources, optimize queries, and design efficient analytical models.
  • Experience designing and delivering customized technical presentations and product demonstrations for audiences ranging from hands-on practitioners to executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into clear business value, adapting communication style to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  • Solid technical foundation, including experience with:
  • JavaScript, HTML/CSS (nice to have; strong preference for hands-on exposure)
  • REST APIs and platform integrations
  • Linux-based environments and containerized architectures (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience providing guidance on authentication and security, including implementing or supporting SSO solutions (SAML 2.0, OIDC, JWT).
  • Detailed understanding of analytics embedding, including hands-on implementation using iFrames and related integration patterns.
  • Working knowledge of ETL methodologies, data pipelines, and upstream data preparation concepts.
  • Nice to have: prior experience with technical project management or leading workstreams across cross-functional teams.


What We Offer

  • Employment through a partner agency (B2B).
  • Competitive base salary up to USD 4300 per month (depending on experience).
  • Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics.
  • Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team.
  • Professional development and growth opportunities.
